criteria.requirement: Fix JSONParser.parse_entry date_modified detection/value consistency through actual feedparser.parse. Preserve the original date string and UTC parsed tuple, prefer correct date_modified when both spellings exist and explicitly support legacy date_updated only as fallback without KeyError. Missing modified dates must not create real updated keys from published aliases; invalid strings remain raw with parsed None. Do not replace published or merely rely on FeedParserDict compatibility fallback to claim a modified date exists.
Deliver the authorized source changes, public regression tests that fail on the original version, and English compatibility documentation. All frozen native regression tests must pass.

comparison: Accept equivalent implementations according to actual program behavior; do not grade by matching reference text or its length.
